description: This file defines JSON formatter classes for the behave testing framework, including JSONFormatter and PrettyJSONFormatter, which generate compact and human-readable JSON outputs for test runs.

classes.name: JSONFormatter
classes.description: A formatter class that outputs test run data in JSON format, supporting both compact and detailed output.

classes.name: PrettyJSONFormatter
classes.description: A subclass of JSONFormatter that provides human-readable, indented JSON output.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the current feature, scenario, and step data.

methods.name: uri
methods.description: Placeholder method for handling URI; no implementation.

methods.name: feature
methods.description: Initializes data for a new feature.

methods.name: background
methods.description: Adds background steps to the current feature data.

methods.name: scenario
methods.description: Initializes data for a new scenario.

methods.name: make_table
methods.description: Creates a dictionary representation of a table with headings and rows.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Adds a step to the current feature element.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Associates a step match with arguments.

methods.name: result
methods.description: Records the result of a step execution.

methods.name: embedding
methods.description: Adds an embedding (e.g., image) to the current step.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Handles end of feature processing, writing JSON data.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Finalizes JSON output and closes stream.

methods.name: add_feature_element
methods.description: Adds an element (background or scenario) to feature data.

methods.name: current_feature_element
methods.description: Property to access the current feature element.

methods.name: update_status_data
methods.description: Updates feature data with current feature status.

methods.name: finish_current_scenario
methods.description: Marks the current scenario as finished with its status.

methods.name: write_json_header
methods.description: Writes the start of JSON array.

methods.name: write_json_footer
methods.description: Writes the end of JSON array.

methods.name: write_json_feature
methods.description: Serializes and writes feature data as JSON.

methods.name: write_json_feature_separator
methods.description: Writes separator between features.
